name: DH (Student) Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Confirmed enrollment or training placement (visa symbol DH) at a Vietnamese educational institution.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain admission to an accredited Vietnamese institution.

requirements.blocker_text: The educational institution must issue or arrange an official invitation/guarantee letter for the visa application.

outcome.duration_length: visa up to 1 year; temporary residence card up to 5 years, renewable while enrolled

sources.title: LuatVietnam (private legal database) -- consolidated Law on Entry, Exit, Transit and Residence of Foreigners: DH student/trainee visa category, up to 1 year, Article 9
EIV (education consultancy) -- Vietnam Temporary Residence Card guide: DH-based residence card up to 5 years, institutional documentation requirements

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Vietnam). STATUS: DRAFT, TIER-3 ONLY -- no genuine .gov.vn source with DH-specific procedural detail was found in this pass; both sources are private commercial/consultancy sites. work_rights is 'none' since DH does not itself confer work authorization -- a student wishing to work would need a separate work permit exemption or full labour permit under Decree 152/2020, not modeled as automatic here.
